tender_clause: Nominal storage capacity shall be at least 500 L.
standard_requirement: Nominal storage capacity shall not be less than 500 L.
notes: Direct match on physical parameter capacity.

tender_clause: Operating temperature must be up to 60 °C.
standard_requirement: Maximum operating temperature shall not exceed 40 °C.
notes: Tender requests 60 °C, which exceeds the standard limit of 40 °C.

tender_clause: Salt spray corrosion testing for 1000 hours is strictly required.
standard_requirement: Tensile strength shall not be less than 20 MPa.
notes: Salt spray test is not mentioned in IS 12701 standard requirements.

tender_clause: Valid BIS license and ISI mark as per IS 12701 is mandatory.
standard_requirement: Product conformance shall be verified as per IS 12701.

notes: Tolerance and nominal thickness match standard.

standard_requirement: External diameter shall not exceed 32 mm.
notes: Tender diameter exceeds standard maximum threshold.

tender_clause: Material shall be High Density Polyethylene grade.
standard_requirement: Material shall be virgin food grade polyethylene.
notes: Material category match with standard clause.

tender_clause: Hydrostatic pressure rating shall be 150 mm.
standard_requirement: Working pressure shall be at least 10 bar.
notes: Pressure expressed in length unit 'mm' cannot be verified.

tender_clause: Routine test report from NABL accredited laboratory must be submitted.
standard_requirement: Routine test report and inspection records shall be maintained.

tender_clause: Hydraulic test pressure shall be at least 15 bar.
standard_requirement: Hydraulic test pressure shall be at least 15 bar.

tender_clause: Comprehensive onsite warranty for 5 years is mandatory.
standard_requirement: Nominal storage capacity shall not be less than 500 L.
notes: Commercial warranty is absent from technical standard.

tender_clause: Delivery timeline shall not exceed 4 weeks from order.
standard_requirement: Nominal storage capacity shall not be less than 500 L.
notes: Commercial delivery term absent from technical standard.

tender_clause: Motor efficiency shall be at least 90 %.
standard_requirement: Motor efficiency shall be at least 85 %.
notes: Tender requirement satisfies and exceeds standard minimum threshold.

tender_clause: Acoustic noise level shall not exceed 65 dB.
standard_requirement: Acoustic noise level shall not exceed 70 dB.
notes: Tender maximum 65 dB satisfies standard maximum 70 dB.

tender_clause: Total unit weight shall not exceed 5 kg.
standard_requirement: Maximum operating temperature shall not exceed 40 °C.
notes: Weight limitation is not specified in standard.
